admission.justification: The archive hook and cleanup request carry one explicit task environment root, preventing master/sprint close from leaving live explainers behind or leaf cleanup from retiring an environment it does not own.

applicability: Task retirement/archive cleanup hooks and ReviewArtifactCleanupRequest. Transaction ownership remains the existing close operation.
conditions: A master/sprint task close supplies its own explainer root to the cleanup hook.
Preview leaves environments unchanged and lists exact would-retire identities.
exclusions: Leaf finalize, abandon or cleanup when explainer_root is None.
Calling a partial/failed environment cleanup successful because the enclosing transaction already committed.
statement: Master or sprint task close retires that task own explainer environments through the same cleanup hook, deriving their root from coordination/repository/task rather than the moved archive directory. A preview lists exact would-retire leaf/agent/generation entries and retires nothing. Partial or failed environment cleanup is retained as failed hook evidence; leaf finalize/abandon/cleanup carries no explainer root and does not retire the environment.
